_SHOW_TOOL_ACTIVITY: default for mirroring 🔧 tool steps. /tools on|off in a topic (add 'all' for the whole chat) overrides it at runtime and persists in toolprefs.json
_TOPIC_OPENER: first message posted into a new topic: off | minimal (one line) | full (paragraph + where-it-left-off seed)
_APPEARANCE: boot-time group + bot appearance; carries only what should differ from the live objects. Unset fields are left untouched. Photo is only set when the group has NONE (representative per-group icons you set by hand are never overwritten; add force_photo:true on a chat to override). Photo paths are relative to the install dir.

APPEARANCE.bot_about: Bridges the Claude Code sessions running on my computer, over Telegram topics.
APPEARANCE.bot_description: Private, local-first gateway for the Claude Code sessions running on my computer. Every active session gets its own topic and mirrors live; reply in a topic to steer it, or /new to start a fresh one. Allowlisted users only.

_TITLE_MODE: first-message (free) | session-name | generated — 'generated' spawns a Claude turn per topic-creation attempt, ~25k tokens each
